name: happy-path
title: Desktop checkout: totals and order confirmation
objective: On the shop home page click the button 'Add to cart: Ceramic Mug' twice and 'Add to cart: Canvas Tote' once. Open the Cart page. Verify the cart shows Subtotal $42.50, Shipping $5.00, Tax $4.25 and Order total $51.75. Click 'Proceed to checkout'. Fill the form: Full name 'Ada Lovelace', Email 'ada@example.com', Street address '12 Analytical St', City 'Cambridge', ZIP code '02139', Card number '4242 4242 4242 4242'. Click 'Place order'. Verify the page now says 'Thank you for your order!' with an order number and 'Amount charged: $51.75'.
